title: LCA Presents : Todd Oliver
seo_title: Todd Oliver Ventriloquist Show in Lebanon, MO | Feb 8
description: Todd Oliver, a nationally recognized ventriloquist and comedian, performs a family-friendly show with laughter, magic, and music, featuring his talking dog Irving and a rotating cast of characters. It takes place Monday, February 8, 2027 at 7:00 PM at the Cowan Civic Center, 500 East Elm Street in Lebanon, MO, as part of LCA Presents.
